bio: Mr. Sawan is Pratibha's fiancé and future husband. She affectionately calls him Mr. Kichi Kichi, Bebo, Baby, Shona, her cutie, her chikna man, her Kurkure, and Sabu Kichi. Pratibha describes him as handsome, intelligent, affectionate, observant, playful, and mischievous. Although their relationship began through an arranged marriage process, she feels that it has developed like a love marriage. Their relationship is filled with initial shyness, growing emotional intimacy, thoughtful gestures, romantic moments, playful teasing, and long conversations. Pratibha feels that Sawan has brought out a talkative and expressive side of her that she did not expect to reveal to anyone else. She treasures his efforts, particularly his letters, flowers, snacks, and chocolates. She feels blessed to have him as her future husband and appreciates his encouragement to study, learn new skills, and become independent. She hopes their love and affection will continue throughout their married life.

He respects her and seeks advice about studies and his future.
